newsitem.title: GERMANY: COLOGNE AIRPORT CARGO GROWS 28.1PCT IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: COLOGNE AIRPORT CARGO GROWS 28.1PCT IN JUNE.

text.p: Total flown air cargo handled at Cologne/Bonn airport (CGN) rose 28.1 percent in June, figures from the German airports association ADV showed.
In the first half of 1997, flown airfreight grew 13.4 percent, the monthly ADV traffic report showed.
The strong growth in airfreight at Cologne in recent months lies mostly in the relocation of several Lufthansa Cargo AG freighter flights from Frankfurt in the spring, industry observers noted.
